question: What is the per-axis joint-LM basin radius around truth and body-twin on seeds 23/28/89, and which axis is binding?
hypothesis: The LM basin is wide in q0 and narrow in omega; the binding axis is seed-specific.
narrative_md: Joint 6-DOF LM basin radii from controlled perturbations off truth/twin on seeds 23/28/89. The LM basin is wide in q0 (>=30deg saturated on most axes) but narrow in omega; binding axis is seed-specific (omega-mag +-7% seed 23, +2%/-3% seed 28, omega-dir + q0-perp seed 89). Seed 89 is uniquely asymmetric (truth q0-perp 5deg vs twin 20deg) due to a competing rho~11 attractor. Cohort implication: the omega-prior (within ~2% mag) is the binding constraint, not q0 IC density — the cell-filter matters most.
